claims.claim: BK potassium channels show 10–20 times higher unitary conductance in mammals and birds than in invertebrates.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology used molecular simulations in the STEPS program and evolutionary mapping across species to examine why BK potassium channels show 10–20 times higher unitary conductance in mammals and birds than in invertebrates.
claims.source_title: More current with less calcium: Computational models help solve longstanding ion channel evolution mystery
claims.supporting_quote: Across the animal kingdom, BK channels show significantly higher unitary conductance than other types of potassium ion channels, sometimes 10–20 times as high.

claims.claim: Two agents, 5-fluorouracil and olaparib, produced nearly identical profiles in conventional 2D layers yet showed distinct morphological changes when cells were imaged individually inside the spheres.

claims.supporting_quote: Two of them, the chemotherapy 5-fluorouracil and the targeted cancer drug olaparib, were nearly indistinguishable in flat cultures but clearly different in minispheres.

claims.claim: The team made the minispheres transparent using a sugar and glycerol solution so microscopes could capture thousands of shape and structure details from cells deep inside each cluster.
claims.episode_span: The team made the minispheres transparent using a sugar and glycerol solution so microscopes could capture thousands of shape and structure details from cells deep inside each cluster.
claims.source_title: Transparent minispheres reveal that some look-alike cancer drugs part ways in 3D
claims.supporting_quote: They then made the minispheres transparent with a simple solution of sugar and glycerol, so the microscope could see individual cells deep inside them, and measured thousands of details of each cell's shape and structure.

claims.claim: Erik De Schutter noted that BK channels regulate cell firing across neurons and that the work supplies a possible answer to why these high-conductance channels developed.
